# Dashboard — Additional Costs Card (deep composition)

- **Context:** The `/app` dashboard (`.specs/frontend-screens/SPEC.md`) lists an `AdditionalCostsSection` card. This doc deepens that single card from the supplied mockup (`pasted-1.png` / `pasted-2.png`) into an implementable composition. Names are kept identical to `SPEC.md` (`AdditionalCostsSection`, `AdditionalCostRow`, `DiscountToggle`) — this is a **refinement**, not a new screen.
- **Goal:** Lock the component tree, anatomy, data flow, and reuse decisions for the "Custos Adicionais" card so `/route` is untouched and `/component` + `/form` can build it against the existing primitives.
- **Decisions:**
  - The card header is the bk-dash "purple coin" idiom → reuse `GradientIconBadge` (`@/components/ui/gradient-icon-badge.tsx`), not a hand-rolled circle.
  - The `+` on `Operacional` / `Garantia` rows opens an **add-custom-cost Dialog** (web) via `useDialogStore` — the mockup's `+` is the "+ Novo X" affordance the skill says implies a Dialog. `SPEC.md` called it a "drawer"; on `packages/app/react` the canonical overlay is a Dialog. On expo it would be a sheet (out of scope here).
  - `Descontar Custos Adicionais` recomputes the dashboard-wide **profit** (consumed by `StatCardsSection`), so it must survive refresh and refetch `GetDashboard` → it lives in **URL search param `discountExtra: boolean`**, not `useState`. This supersedes the `[discount]` local-state note on row 817 of `SPEC.md`.
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - AC-1. Card renders coin header (icon + "Custos Adicionais" + total), a discount toggle, and 5 cost rows from a single `GetDashboard.additionalCosts` slice.
  - AC-2. Rows are red-valued; `Operacional` and `Garantia` expose a `+` that opens the add-cost dialog; other rows do not.
  - AC-3. Toggling discount writes `discountExtra` to the URL and refetches the consolidated query.
  - AC-4. No new primitive is created — every element maps to an existing `@/components/ui/*`.

## UI Composition

> Scope: the `AdditionalCostsSection` card only. The Route Shell (`DashboardRoute`) and sibling sections are specified in `.specs/frontend-screens/SPEC.md`; reproduced here read-only for context.

### URL Contract

- **Path:** `/app/dashboard` (existing — owned by `DashboardRoute`, **not** created by this card)
- **Breadcrumb:** `Dashboard`
- **Search params (Zod sketch) — this card reads/writes:**
  - `storeId` — `string | 'national' | 'all'` — read (scopes the query) — *defined by Route Shell*
  - `currency` — `string` — read (formats values) — *defined by Route Shell*
  - `startDate` / `endDate` — `string (ISO datetime)` — read (period of the cost breakdown) — *defined by Route Shell*
  - `discountExtra` — `boolean` (default `false`) — **written by this card** via `DiscountToggle`; consumed by `GetDashboard` so `StatCardsSection`'s profit recomputes
- **Loader:** none (data via React Query hook in the Section)
- **errorComponent:** `RouteError` (default, on the Route Shell)

### ASCII Layout Map

│  ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  │

### Component Tree

└─ AdditionalCostsSection                                   (Section, owns GetDashboard.additionalCosts slice)
   ├─ DiscountToggle                                        (Component, writes ?discountExtra)

### Data Cards

| Name | Role | Data | URL r/w | Store r/w | Local | Reuse decision | File | Skill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AdditionalCostsSection | Section | `useGetDashboard()` → `.additionalCosts` | reads: [storeId, currency, startDate, endDate, discountExtra] | — | — | create-route-local | `routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/AdditionalCostsSection/index.tsx` | /component |
| DiscountToggle | Component | — | reads: [discountExtra], writes: [discountExtra] | — | — | create-route-local | `…/-components/AdditionalCostsSection/DiscountToggle.tsx` | /component |
| AdditionalCostRow | Leaf | props from `AdditionalCostsSection` (`{ icon, label, value, editable, category }`) | — | — | — | create-route-local | `…/-components/AdditionalCostsSection/AdditionalCostRow.tsx` | /component |
| AddCostDialog | Dialog | owns `useAddAdditionalCost` mutation | — | `useDialogStore` (show) | — | create-route-local | `…/-components/AdditionalCostsSection/AddCostDialog/index.tsx` | /component |
| AddCostForm | Form | `AddAdditionalCostSchema` (SDK) | — | — | TanStack `useForm` | create-route-local | `…/-components/AdditionalCostsSection/AddCostDialog/AddCostForm.tsx` | /form |

**Per-node notes:**

- **AdditionalCostsSection:** ARIA `role="list" aria-label="Custos adicionais"`. Total is the sum of the 5 row values (display-only). Skeleton: header + 5 bars. Rationale: dashboard-finance coupled, single consumer → route-local.
- **DiscountToggle:** ARIA on Checkbox `aria-label="Descontar Custos Adicionais"`. Writes `discountExtra` via `navigate({ search })`; the consolidated `GetDashboard` query keyed on it refetches (profit in `StatCardsSection` updates). Supersedes `SPEC.md` row-817 `[discount]` useState.
- **AdditionalCostRow:** `+` AddButton is icon-only → `aria-label="Adicionar custo de <label>"`. Value uses `text-danger` regardless of sign (cost convention). Rows: Chargeback `CardIcon`, Reembolso `RefundIcon`, Impostos `BalanceIcon`, Operacional `ToolIcon` (editable), Garantia `LockIcon` (editable).
- **AddCostDialog:** opened via `useDialogStore.show(<AddCostDialog category={row.category} />)` — never `open`/`onOpenChange`. ARIA from `Dialog` primitive (title). Route-local because used only on dashboard (UIC-C01: 1 consumer).
- **AddCostForm:** validators from SDK `AddAdditionalCostSchema`; `amount` uses the money input mask; on success invalidates the `GetDashboard` query key + closes dialog.

### Reuse Summary

- **Reuse (no work) — primitives:**
  - `Card` — `@/components/ui/card.tsx`
  - `GradientIconBadge` — `@/components/ui/gradient-icon-badge.tsx` (the purple coin header)
  - `Checkbox` — `@/components/ui/checkbox.tsx`
  - `Separator` — `@/components/ui/separator.tsx`
  - `Button` — `@/components/ui/button.tsx` (the `+` and dialog actions)
  - `Dialog` — `@/components/ui/dialog.tsx`
  - `Input` — `@/components/ui/input.tsx` (form fields)
  - Icons — `MoneyBoxIcon, CardIcon, RefundIcon, BalanceIcon, ToolIcon, LockIcon, PlusIcon` all exist in `@/components/ui/icons/`
- **Promote to shared:** none. `AdditionalCostRow` is a generic "icon · label · action · money value" row, but only one consumer exists today → keep route-local (bp-06). Re-evaluate if a second screen needs the same row shape.
- **Create new shared:** none.
- **Create route-local:** `AdditionalCostsSection`, `DiscountToggle`, `AdditionalCostRow`, `AddCostDialog`, `AddCostForm` — all dashboard-finance coupled, single consumer.

> No `StatCard` reuse: this is a multi-row composite (coin header + toggle + list), not the single-row KPI `StatCard`. They share only the `GradientIconBadge` primitive, which both consume independently.

| 1 | (reuse) | primitives | `@/components/ui/*` | all exist — no `/primitive` step needed |
| 2 | /component | AdditionalCostsSection | `routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/AdditionalCostsSection/index.tsx` | owns `useGetDashboard().additionalCosts`; reads `discountExtra` |

| 4 | /component | AdditionalCostRow | `…/AdditionalCostsSection/AdditionalCostRow.tsx` | Leaf; props only; `+` for editable rows |
| 5 | /component | AddCostDialog | `…/AdditionalCostsSection/AddCostDialog/index.tsx` | `useDialogStore`; owns `useAddAdditionalCost` |
| 6 | /form | AddCostForm | `…/AddCostDialog/AddCostForm.tsx` | TanStack Form + `AddAdditionalCostSchema` |

> The Route Shell (`/route`) and `?discountExtra` schema addition belong to the existing `DashboardRoute` — extend its search schema; do not create a new route.

- OQ-1. `Operacional`/`Garantia` `+` → **add-cost mutation** (`AddAdditionalCostSchema`, `useAddAdditionalCost`) is assumed but not yet in the SDK (BFF rebuild in progress per recent commits). Confirm the controller/schema name before `/form`. Proposed: `POST /dashboard/additional-costs { category, name, amount }`.
